linos wrote: I suppose this is the logic behind the IQM. helps identify where ITs will decide to FO to.

Let me know if I a missing it.

Hi Linos, the QM level is also a H&S to the retail crowd. so at that
 level there are often a truck load of orders. if we dont see price
react and hit an opposing TG but rather slice through it, it shows an
area of conviction. If we get our signal beyond the iqm it can be a
great place upon return

author: Ifmyante
text:
Enlightenme wrote: Hi Linos,

First of all, it seems like you are doing really great. At the moment, I
 am not confident to take trades. However, you on the other hand, are
doing 23 & 17 RR:R. Congratulations! It seems like you are already
on your way.

What I'm seeing from Linos is the maturity to wait for trades which are screaming to be taken.

None of us need to understand every single movement of price, when there are so many trades like the above offering giant R.

None of us should strive to be in the market all the time. If you take
one stupidly simple trade in a month with 20R, you're up 40%, which is
four times what most can hope for in a year!

Don't just try to learn Linos' technical method. Learn his patience too
